bank_name: ICB Islamic Bank Limited (formerly The Oriental Bank Limited / Al-Baraka Bank Bangladesh Limited)
period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), compared against the prior 31-December-2019 audited position. Income-statement items recorded here are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2020 (9-month YTD, 'Taka(YTD)' column), per this dataset's standard convention. The source filing ALSO independently discloses discrete 3-month (1 July - 30 September 2020) figures directly, not derived by this dataset: net profit after tax BDT 111,124,767 (EPS 0.17) for Q3-2020 discrete vs a loss of BDT (129,946,958) (EPS (0.20)) for Q3-2019 discrete -- not stored as separate line items here, to keep the schema consistent with the cumulative-only convention used across this dataset (see CITYBANK 2024_Q1.json), but cited here because it is directly relevant: this is the SAME quarter celebrated in the FY2020 Annual Report's Directors'/CEO commentary as 'the first time in the history of ICB Islamic Bank' the bank posted a discrete quarterly after-tax profit (annual report gives BDT 112.12mn / EPS 0.17 for Jul-Sep 2020, a rounding-level presentation difference from this filing's precise 111,124,767 -- both round to EPS 0.17). The annual report's cumulative comparatives also match this filing exactly: 9M-2020 EPS (0.15), 9M-2019 EPS (0.49), NOCFPS 9M-2020 0.391 vs 9M-2019 0.003, NAV/share 30-Sep-20 (17.41). SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF layout is a complex multi-column table (four income-statement columns side by side: 9M-2020, 9M-2019, Q3-2020-discrete, Q3-2019-discrete) that pdftotext -layout renders with heavy left-right interleaving of unrelated columns (balance sheet / P&L / cash-flow / notes text all sharing the same physical page); every figure below was manually located and cross-checked against the balance-sheet identity and the full income-statement subtotal chain (A-B=C, C-D=PBT, PBT-tax=PAT, PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS) before being recorded here, all of which tie out exactly (balance sheet off by 1 taka on rounding: liabilities 23,150,463,581 + equity -11,571,557,653 = 11,578,905,928 vs reported total assets 11,578,905,929).

source.source_page_lines: full text digitally extracted (pdftotext, non-scanned PDF); balance sheet, P&L, cash flow statement and statement of changes in equity are printed side-by-side as columns on shared pages rather than sequential pages

line_items.metric_note: Fell from 553.95m (Dec-19) after a BDT -97.61m write-down of the asset-revaluation-reserve component during the period, per the Statement of Changes in Equity ('Surplus/(deficit) on account of revaluation of properties').
